prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE image, then copy the resulting image file to incoming/alcove-spring.png in this repo. Use a 16:9 landscape size at the highest quality. Do not edit any other files. When done, print the saved path and the pixel dimensions.
The attached image (incoming/alcove-autumn.png) is the reference: pass it to the image generation tool as the input image to edit, so the camera, framing and materials stay identical.

Image prompt:
Using the reference image, keep the camera position, framing, plaster wall, wooden floor board, pine post, bronze basin and stone exactly the same. Change only the season to early spring: remove the maple leaves; the moss is fresh pale yellow-green with many tiny upright spore stalks catching the light; one young fern frond is unrolling from behind the stone. Brighter, slightly warmer soft morning daylight from the left. Muted, natural colours, realistic photograph. No text, no people, no other objects. 16:9.
